passages.text: “Mendicant, the mind leads the world on. The mind drags it around. When the mind arises, it takes control.”
passages.note: The mind shapes how we experience the world

passages.text: An astute person with great wisdom is one who has no intention to hurt themselves, or to hurt others, or to hurt both. When they think, they only think of the benefit for themselves, for others, for both, and for the whole world. That’s how an individual is astute, with great wisdom.”
passages.note: Wisdom as wishing harm to no one, including oneself
